title: 30A Kinda Day
meta_description: Welcome to 3BR Redfish Village condo with pool views, private beach access, balcony, \& playground. 30A Kinda Day is your perfect getaway!
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Conveniently located in Blue Mountain Beach's Redfish Village, this top-floor builder's condominium is one of only two units that overlook the pool. It has no adjoining units, resulting in a beautifully quiet and restful vacation with lots of fun activities, delicious, various food and dessert choices nearby. This newly renovated condo has all-new plank flooring, new textured reed blinds, updated bathrooms, new paint/carpets/furniture, and is a perfectly beautiful spot for your family or friends to enjoy the white sandy beaches of the Emerald Coast! With quaint neighboring beach communities galore and miles of white sand beaches to explore, you'll never run out of exciting ways to fill your days. Enjoy the sunsets that overlook the pool! Come experience the magic of a 30A Kinda Day.

ABOUT THE AREA: Blue Mountain Beach is one of the 30A coastal communities that rests between Santa Rosa Beach and Grayton Beach State Park. The Blue Mountain community is known for its tranquility, many restaurants, and family atmosphere. The natural beauty of the sugar sand beaches, walking, biking trails and adventure await you. This complex borders the beautiful Redfish Lake and provides a boardwalk and overlook pavilion to explore the surrounding nature and soak in all the scenery.

BEACH ACCESS: Private beach access, about a 3-block walk (has restrooms, \& shower) just east of Blue Mountain Regional public. This beach access, has parking, coolers, wagons and single inflatable toys are permitted, as well as kayaks and paddle boards.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1-- King, ensuite tub/shower
• Bedroom 2-- 1 King, ensuite shower
• Bedroom 3 - 1 Full/Full Bunk with adjoining tub/shower combo

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Community Pool (seasonally heated)
• Private beach
• Seasonal tram to beach
• Fitness Room
• Enclosed playground, yard area \& games
• Grills -- Propane (community)
• Balcony overlooking pool
• Golf cart charging stations available for a fee through RFV (rental Golf carts)
• Smart TVs in every bedroom - Live Oak internet
• Coffee Maker -- traditional and pod
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath
• Fully stocked kitchen
\*\* No adjoining condos, = no noise. Exclusive private balconies.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach Seaside Community, Watercolor Community, Rosemary Community

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- 1 parking spot in the garage with overflow anywhere in the parking lot.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
